name: mcp-united
description: One Entra-authenticated MCP gateway for Microsoft 365 and Karelin services.

interface.longDescription: MCP United connects ChatGPT, Codex, and Claude to Microsoft 365, Entra, Obsidian, TickTick, OpenViking, and Azure Key Vault through one authenticated MCP gateway. Microsoft 365 access follows the signed-in user's delegated permissions; private services require the configured MCP United role.
defaultPrompt: Read my latest Obsidian daily note with MCP United.
Find my recent Microsoft 365 mail with MCP United.
Search my OpenViking memory with MCP United.
